name: EPIC 210478582
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 9.6 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210478582 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.64713 (16th-84th percentiles 9.369632-9.980348), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210478582: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4982.9043 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210478582 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2846.367188 (16th-84th percentiles 2787.460938-2914.570312), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.83 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,846 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.88 solar masses and 9.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,983 K at its surface.
